Same-patch practice/custom test with exact state: record Sundering Slam first target tooltip, observed AP/AD/HP/mana/resists, per-packet damage/protection and final targetHP. Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Verify raw helper/statFormula mappings and conditional multipliers before treating result as established.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

kitEvidence.formula:
Cunning Sweep: Ambessa sweeps her blades forward, dealing [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] + [0.04 / 0.045 / 0.05 / 0.055 / 0.06 + (0.0003) × AD[statFormula=2]] max Health physical damage to enemies at the edge of the strike. All other enemies take [0.5] damage. Striking an enemy readies a Sundering Slam.

Sundering Slam: Ambessa slams her blades down, dealing [50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2]] + [0.04 / 0.045 / 0.05 / 0.055 / 0.06 + (0.0004) × AD[statFormula=2]] max Health physical damage against the first enemy hit. All other enemies take [0.5] damage.

builds.name: Repudiation: bonus-AD shield ceiling
builds.summary: Investigate high one Repudiation shield output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Repudiation shield output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The shield helper is 50 to 320 by champion level plus 1.5 bonus AD, lasting 1.5 seconds. Bloodmail can convert purchased health into AD; its current low-health component and Spirit Visage shield interaction need actual client readings. The W strike and its conditional 50% damage increase do not multiply this shield.

One fresh W shield with no prior W shield. Record actual bonus AD and current-health Bloodmail contribution. No Conqueror stacks or ally shield buffs assumed.

kitEvidence.formula: Ambessa gains [characterLevelInterpolation(50 → 320; raw flags preserved) + (1.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] Shield for [1.5] seconds and braces herself for [0.5] seconds. She then slams the ground, dealing [50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to nearby enemies, which increases to [(50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (1.5)] physical damage if she braced herself from damage from an enemy champion, large monster, or structure.
